newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system on Thursday through overnight system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"We're looking for an overnight system RP, but just a small one," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International Inc are also expecting the Fed to add reserves via term system RPs.
Saporta estimated the Fed's daily add need in the remaining seven days of the current two-week liquidity maintenance period at $2.2 billion.
At 0905 EST/1405 GMT, federal funds traded at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
